name: AXM Module Footprint Observatory
actions: measure active files and bytes per top-level module
surface each module's largest observed file
group exact file bytes by lowercase extension
record excluded directories and skipped symlinks
summary: Read-only active-source footprint evidence for each top-level Workshop module, with exact file counts, bytes, largest files, extension mix, exclusions, and symlink holds.
notes: Footprint is not quality, complexity, performance, readiness, duplication, importance, or a deletion recommendation. This module never packages, deletes, compresses, installs, promotes, or changes CANON.
